title: The Slayers Next
synopsis:
Let the forces of evil tremble in fear (along with wealthy merchants and innocent bystanders)... THE SLAYERS ARE BACK! Join the not-so-heroic adventures of Lina Inverse--the super-cute sorceress who steals from the rich and keeps it for herself! Along with her sword-swinging (but dumber than dirt) sidekick, Gourry, her hyper-enthusiastic protégé, Amelia, and the tormented and overly-serious golem, Zelgadis, there's nothing Lina can't do!

(Source: Software Sculptors)
search_text: the slayers next スレイヤース next tv finished

episodes.title: The Sudden Pinch! The Terror of the Monstrous Zoamelgustar!
episodes.synopsis: Lina and Gourry hear of the famous "Zoanna's Evil Book" and go to the kingdom of Zoanna.

episodes.title: The Roguish Priest! His Name is Xellos!
episodes.synopsis: Lina and others continue their journey to help Zelgadis find "a copy of Claire Bible."

episodes.title: A Wonderful Business! Being A Bodyguard Isn't Easy!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party arrives at Atlas City. They get into an argument for a trifle and separate into Lina and Gourry, Amelia and Zelgadis groups.

episodes.title: An Ancient Pledge! One Who Seeks Immortality!
episodes.synopsis: To collect the payment, Lina's party requests a meeting with Talim and Damia. They insist that they're not responsible for the beasts. Their guess is that the former director of their association, Harsheyfom, was behind this.

episodes.title: Staying Behind for the Sake of Love!
episodes.synopsis: Lina and others run around the house, looking for the "Rock of Contract."

episodes.title: You Can't Escape! The Return of the Obsessive Martina!
episodes.synopsis: After Atlas City, Lina's party gets back on the road. However, there's a shadow after them.

episodes.title: Sudden Cooking! Follow the Phantom Dragon!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party continues their journey to Sayloon kingdom. On their way, Lina sees the sign for the "legendary dragon food" and gets excited.

episodes.title: Be Eternal! The Day Prince Phil Died?
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets to Sayloon kingdom. However, what waited for them was the funeral of Amelia's father, the first successor of the kingship of the country, Phil.

episodes.title: Hidden Ambitions! The Shocking Confession?
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party finds out that the evils are after Sayloon kingdom, and go into the castle with Phil.

episodes.title: On a Journey With a Pack of Scoundrels?! Take Back That Magic Power!
episodes.synopsis: Lina decides to visit a magic doctor who resides deep in the mountains in order to regain her magical power.

episodes.title: Voices of Darkness! Slash 'Em to Bits, Ragna Blade!
episodes.synopsis: Lina can't regain her magical power and gets depressed. Then she notices a signal fire going up in Sayloon kingdom.

episodes.title: The Unexpected End? The Shocking Truth!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets depressed from having lost Phil to the evils.

episodes.title: Impending Fall! The Moment of Ambition's Defeat!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party beats Magenta, and are psyched up for beating Kanzel.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Dance? Where is the Strongest Spell?
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party learns about the presence of a high level monster an evil Dragon Lord called Garp behind the series of recent evil activity.

episodes.title: A Big Crash? The Battle at Artemay Tower?
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party continues their journey to find the Claire Bible.

episodes.title: Bitter Curve Balls! Gutsy Fast Balls!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets to a town and gets the information that a copy of the Bible is on the trophy which is given to the winner of a magic tennis competition.

episodes.title: They're Talking About a Girl Named Zelgadis?!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets the information that a copy of the Bible is in the country where only women live.

episodes.title: The Temple of Sand! The Secret of the Giga Slave!
episodes.synopsis: While Lina's party continues to look for a copy of the Bible, Zerros brings them the information that a perfect copy is at a castle nearby.

episodes.title: Disclosure at Last?! Xellos' True Form!
episodes.synopsis: The evil Dragon Lord, Garp, presses Lina's party.

episodes.title: No Other Choice! Set Course for Dragon Valley!
episodes.synopsis: After barely escaping from Garp, Lina's party heads to Dragon Valley in Catart mountain range to find a copy of Claire Bible.

episodes.title: The Thousand Year Old Truth! The Traitorous Demon Dragon King!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets away from the monsters and go into the cave where the Bible is supposed to be.

episodes.title: The Stolen Sword of Light! The End of the Demon Dragon King!
episodes.synopsis: Garp puts Lina's party in a pinch. Then appears the most powerful evil Lord, Fiblizo, who came after the traitor Garp.

episodes.title: The Menacing Swordsman! A Journey of Reunion!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets depressed for having lost Gourry. Silfeel, who fought with them in Saylague, appears, learns of Gourry, and decides to fight with them.

episodes.title: Sinister Trap! The Mysterious City of Ghosts!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party gets to Saylague to rescue Gourry. Saylague was destroyed by the battle with clone Rezo, but now it's revived as the town of the dead by Fiblizo's magic.

episodes.title: The Souls of the Dead! Lina's Final Decision!
episodes.synopsis: Lina's party faces Fiblizo, but none of their magic works on him.

episodes.title: Go to NEXT! And Then Again?
episodes.synopsis: Giga Slave gets out of control, and the golden evil Lord, the Lord of Nightmares puts Lina unconscious.
